title: Binance says it has finished its recovery work and fully lifted its withdrawal suspension, after a record $6.3B was stolen in a hack last month (Rajveer Singh Pardesi/Reuters)
summary: Rajveer Singh Pardesi / Reuters: Binance says it has finished its recovery work and fully lifted its withdrawal suspension, after a record $6.3B was stolen in a hack last month — Binance said on Thursday its withdrawal recovery work is complete and it has lifted its withdrawal suspension after a record $6.3 billion was stolen in a hack last month.
